key_insight: Kernel Autoresearch turns kernel design into open-ended program discovery while guaranteeing validity through construction contracts, enabling diverse, reusable inductive biases beyond fixed kernel grammars.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical path to automatically generate interpretable kernels that can improve optimization and scientific modeling, especially when hand-designed kernel families are too restrictive.
method: Coding agents synthesize kernel programs instead of selecting only from a fixed grammar.
Construction contracts ensure every accepted kernel is valid, even in open-ended search.
A quality-diversity archive plus novelty screening promotes distinct, high-performing kernels.
evidence_signal: In stress tests, 22–58% of LLM-generated kernels that passed random-input checks failed at different scales or dimensions, while discovered kernels outperformed deep/meta-learned and tuned baselines on held-out optimization and enzyme-kinetics tasks.
watch_item: Open-ended generation still needs robust contract checks and validation across scales/dimensions, since superficially valid kernels can fail outside the test conditions.
paper_title: Kernel Autoresearch for Open-Ended Model Discovery
